description: Use this when an older client expects the single setup tool. Without session_id it starts setup and immediately returns authorization_url plus finish arguments; with session_id it checks once and returns pending, expired, or the complete installation contract. It never opens a browser or blocks. New agents should prefer paydirt_begin_setup and paydirt_finish_setup.

app_description.description: Optional app description to save when creating or repairing setup

app_name.description: Preferred app name to reuse or create during setup

bundle_id.description: Preferred iOS bundle ID to match during setup

feature_placement.description: Developer-confirmed placement for Suggest a Feature, such as settings or after_successful_export. Defaults to settings.

form_plan_confirmed.description: Set true only after the developer confirms cancellation, Suggest a Feature, or a customized form plan. Without confirmation, setup returns a concise confirmation prompt and does not start authorization.

session_id.description: Setup session returned by the first call. When present, this call behaves like paydirt_finish_setup.

subscription_product_ids.description: Native StoreKit auto-renewable product IDs. Required for a complete storekit integration.

subscription_provider.description: Subscription source of truth discovered in the host app. Use auto only when it could not be resolved before setup.

use_cases.description: Confirmed feedback experiences to install. The recommended plan is Suggest a Feature plus trial and paid cancellation when subscriptions exist.

name: paydirt_setup
